claims.text: EasyExcel's official README documents a per-row callback listener read model and warns that major-version upgrades can have incompatibilities; its published performance figures are environment-specific examples rather than generic capacity guarantees.

The candidate explicitly marks batch size, concurrency, queue depth, connection-pool limits and timeout as pressure-test-derived deployment parameters, rather than asserting vendor defaults or universal numeric thresholds.

validation.source_check: 2026-07-11 EasyExcel upstream README checked; design capacity values intentionally remain pressure-test assumptions.
